summary_en: This Phase 1 study is testing BGC515 capsules in people with advanced solid tumors, including mesothelioma and epithelioid hemangioendothelioma. BGC515 is taken by mouth once a day in 21-day cycles, and in the first part of the study the dose is raised in steps. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug (pharmacokinetics), and preliminary efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 prueba las cápsulas de BGC515 en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluidos el mesotelioma y el hemangioendotelioma epitelioide. BGC515 se toma por vía oral una vez al día en ciclos de 21 días, y en la primera parte del estudio la dosis se aumenta por etapas. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el organismo procesa el medicamento (farmacocinética) y los primeros signos de eficacia.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with advanced solid tumors, including mesothelioma or epithelioid hemangioendothelioma.
Disease got worse on standard treatment, standard treatment was not tolerated, or standard treatment is declined or not accessible.
Expansion part: other advanced solid tumors with Hippo signaling pathway abnormalities.
ECOG performance score of 0 or 1 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
At least one measurable lesion and a signed informed consent form.
not_for: Previous or current use of TEAD inhibitors.
Inadequate washout from prior therapies, as described in the protocol.
Severe or unstable systemic disease, or unstable or symptomatic brain (CNS) metastases.
Clinically significant cardiovascular disease, as defined in the protocol.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or known allergy to BGC515 or its ingredients or excipients.
